description: JSON schema for roblox-ts-specific options in tsconfig.json. Reference via "$schema" at the top of your tsconfig.json to get IDE autocomplete and validation for both standard TypeScript options and the "rbxts" field.

rbxts.description: roblox-ts compiler options. CLI flags override these at runtime.

allowCommentDirectives.description: Allow TypeScript comment directives such as @ts-ignore.

includePath.description: Path to where the runtime library files should be stored. Resolved relative to this tsconfig.json.

logTruthyChanges.description: Log changes to truthiness evaluation from Lua truthiness rules.

optimizedArrayAppends.description: Replace eligible Array.push calls in loops with indexed writes.

rojo.description: Path to the Rojo configuration file. Resolved relative to this tsconfig.json. If omitted, roblox-ts auto-detects a *.project.json in the project root.

title: roblox-ts tsconfig.json
